component.name: xgdk
component.summary: Run the Microsoft Store and Xbox GDK titles you own on Linux

description.p: xgdk downloads and launches Microsoft Store (MSIXVC) and Xbox GDK titles on Linux, using a patched Proton and a from-scratch implementation of the Xbox Game Development Kit runtime.

You must own the games. This application ships no game content, no licences and no content keys. It signs in with your own Microsoft account, uses your own licences, and downloads your own purchases. If your account does not own or have a Game Pass entitlement for a title, there is nothing here that will let you play it.
Known state of the supported titles:

ul.li: Minecraft for Windows (Bedrock): signs in, plays, and joins third-party servers
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33: playable, including saves and video
Forza Horizon 5: downloads but does not run, blocked by protection inside the title

description.p: The patched Proton runtime is roughly 264 MiB compressed, versions independently of this application, and is not part of this package.
Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Microsoft, Mojang, Valve or the Xodus project.
Placeholder build. The launcher binary does not exist yet; the packaged command drives the repository's shell scripts so the packaging itself can be tested.
